2609.13396.title: Converge Then Diversify: Decoupling Convergence and Diversity in Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimisation
2609.13396.paper_summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimisation (MOBO) is a sample-efficient approach for optimising expensive black-box functions with multiple objectives. In MOBO, the goal is to adequately approximate the Pareto front; that is, to obtain a high-quality solution set with 1) good convergence (closeness to the Pareto front) and 2) good diversity (spread across the Pareto front). Existing MOBO methods typically aim to accomplish these two tasks simultaneously, i.e., driving the search towards the Pareto front while maintaining a diverse set of nondominated solutions, such that the solutions, ideally, can gradually approach the entire front. When sufficient search budgets are available, this approach is effective. However, considering both convergence and diversity throughout the search is not easy and requires careful design. Under very tight budgets, there may not be enough solutions generated to be able to simultaneously approach the entire Pareto front. To address this issue, this paper proposes a \textit{converge-then-diversify} (CTD) approach that decouples convergence and diversity into two stages. In the first stage, CTD focuses on convergence, aiming to quickly drive the search toward a single point on the Pareto front. In the second stage, CTD focuses on diversity, aiming to spread solutions across the front. We present two simple instantiations of CTD by using widely adopted acquisition functions in the area. Experimental results show that, across all 446 pairwise comparisons, CTD statistically outperforms state-of-the-art methods in 72.9\% of the cases, performs equivalently in 21.1\%, and is statistically worse in only 6.1\%, with the advantage being particularly evident in settings with very tight evaluation budgets or in high-dimensional problems.
2609.13396.paper_summary_zh: 多目標貝葉斯優化（MOBO）是一種樣本效率高的方式，用於優化具有多個目標的昂貴黑箱函數。在MOBO中，目標是充分近似帕累托前沿；也就是說，獲得一組高質量的解集，具有1) 良好的收斂性（接近帕累托前沿）和2) 良好的多樣性（在帕累托前沿上分佈）。現有的MOBO方法通常旨在同時完成這兩個任務，即推動搜索朝向帕累托前沿，同時保持一組多樣的非支配解，使得這些解理想上能夠逐漸接近整個前沿。當可用的搜索預算充足時，這種方法是有效的。然而，在整個搜索過程中考慮收斂性和多樣性並不容易，並且需要仔細設計。在預算非常緊張的情況下，可能無法生成足夠的解來同時接近整個帕累托前沿。為了解決這個問題，本文提出了一種\textit{先收斂後多樣化}（CTD）的方法，將收斂性和多樣性分解為兩個階段。在第一階段，CTD專注於收斂，旨在迅速將搜索推向帕累托前沿上的一個單一點。在第二階段，CTD專注於多樣性，旨在在前沿上分散解。我們通過使用該領域廣泛採用的獲取函數，展示了CTD的兩個簡單實例。實驗結果顯示，在所有446對比中，CTD在72.9\%的情況下統計上優於最先進的方法，在21.1\%的情況下表現相當，僅在6.1\%的情況下統計上較差，這一優勢在評估預算非常緊張或高維問題的情況下尤為明顯。
